name: Chan ga hap tau xi
summary: Chicken feet steamed with tàu xì, fermented black beans, from the Hoa dim-sum table in Tây Ninh.
origin: Hoa kitchens in Tây Ninh. The cooking is Teochew and Cantonese in origin, adapted to local ingredients.
howToEat: Order it with the rest of the dim sum: há cảo, xíu mại, bánh bao, bánh bao kim sa, and chân gà hấp tàu xì.
seoTitle: Chan ga hap tau xi in Tay Ninh
seoDescription: Chân gà hấp tàu xì, chicken feet steamed with black beans, from Tây Ninh’s Hoa dim sum.
